families.name: higher_timeframe_alignment
families.why_short_only: Keeps shorts only when weekly and monthly downside context are aligned enough to justify a close entry.
families.expected_short_quality_effect: hit rate up, median ret20 up, fewer trend-misaligned shorts

families.name: range_middle_suppression
families.why_short_only: Suppresses shorts that sit inside broad range-middle noise rather than on a real downside edge.
families.expected_short_quality_effect: hit rate up, median ret20 up, fewer range-middle false shorts

families.name: support_break_validity
families.why_short_only: Filters shorts that are already too extended below support or are likely to mean-revert into noise.
families.expected_short_quality_effect: hit rate up, median ret20 up, fewer already-fallen shorts
